questions.question: Four words have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the word that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Option 1:- Slavery means bondage.**

Option 2:- Convenience means the quality of being easy, useful, or suit able for somebody.

Option 3:- Choice means an act of choosing between two or more people or things.

The meaning of options 2, 3, and 4 is positive or to make something but option 1 meaning is negative.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All balls are fans.

No fan is a player.

Some players are wickets.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some players are fans.

II. Some wickets are balls.

III. Some fans are balls.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The Venn diagram is given below:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/702579c1fbace7139c6c1c990ebf727d2caaf75cf213152c9c4203ac87f500aa.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some players are fans → False (No fan is a player given so, never some players are fans)

II. Some wickets are balls → False (All balls are fans, no fan is a player, some players are wickets. So, no relation between wickets and balls.)

III. Some fans are balls → True (All balls are fans. So some fans are balls also true.)

Hence, **"option 4"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Suppose for an Example: **All A are B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/343041d8a2f5008fe30b0360a5c22f53cce0592cc6e4f66418d07f0a9530f348.png] 

If we go from** In to Out** means from A to B then **cases with All and some will be true like All A are B and Some A are B.**

But if we go **Out to In** then only cases with **Some will be true and All will be can't say like Some B are A will be true but All B are A will be can't say.**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(7, 12, 18)
questions.solution:
The logic is followed here-

**1) Addition of 1st number and 1st number minus 2 (1st number - 2) then we get 2nd number, **

**2) Then we add 2nd number and 1st number minus 1 (1st number - 1) then we get 3rd number.**

For (7, 12, 18)

7 + (7 - 2) = 7 + 5 = 12

12 + (7 - 1) = 12 + 6 = 18

Similarly,

From option 1:-

For (6, 12, 15)

6 + (6 - 2) = 6 + 4 = 10 ≠ 12

10 + (6 - 1) = 10 + 5 = 15

So, It is not correct.

From option 2:-

For (4, 6, 8)

4 + (4 - 2) = 4 + 2 = 6 

6 + (4 - 1) = 6 + 3 = 9 ≠ 8

So, It is not correct.

From option 3:-

For (5, 9, 11)

5 + (5 - 2) = 5 + 3 = 8 ≠ 9

8 + (5 - 1) = 8 + 4 = 12 ≠ 11

So, It is not correct.

From option 4:-

For **(8, 14, 21)**

**8 + (8 - 2) = 8 + 6 = 14**

**14 + (8 - 1) = 14 + 7 = 21**

**So, It is correct.**

Hence,** "option 4" **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 4
 10
 16
 
 

 6
 4
 13
 
 

 8
 ?
 26
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

__**First number × 1.5 + Second number = Third number**__

**In the first row:**

⇒ 4 (First number) × 1.5 = 6

⇒ 6 (Number obtained) + 10 (Second number) = 16 (Third number)

**In the second row:**

⇒ 6 (First number) × 1.5 = 9

⇒ 9 (Number obtained) + 4 (Second number) = 13 (Third number)

**In the third row:**

⇒ 8 (First number) × 1.5 = 12

⇒ 12 (Number obtained) × X = 26

⇒ X = 26 - 12

Hence, the correct answer is **"14".**

questions.question: 2 train tickets from Mohali to Delhi and 3 tickets from Mohali to Jammu cost ₹800. But 3 tickets from Mohali to Delhi and 2 tickets from Mohali to Jammu cost ₹700. What are the ticket prices for Delhi and Jammu, respectively, from Mohali?
questions.solution:
Let tickets from Mohali to Delhi = x

Tickets from Mohali to Jammu = y

Given that:-

2x + 3y = 800 .................(I)

3x + 2y = 700 ................(II)

We multiply 3 in equation (I) and multiply 2 in equation (II) we get:-

6x + 9y = 2400

6x + 4y = 1400, Now solve both equations, we get:-

y = ₹200 (tickets price from Mohali to Jammu)

x = ₹100 (tickets price from Mohali to Delhi) 

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of then given series will complete the series.

h _ c g _ h k _ g l _ k c _ l
questions.solution:
Given :- h _ c g _ h k _ g l _ k c _ l

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1:- c h l k g → h **c** c g **h** - h k **l** g l - **k** k c **g** l 

2:- g h l c k → h g c g h - h k l g l - c k c k l 

3:- **k l c h g **→ h k c g l - h k c g l - h k c g l

 ♦ (Repetition of h k c g l).

4:- l g k h c → h l c g g - h k k g l - h k c c l 

 ♦ Option (3) gives a pattern of **h k c g l** - h k c g l - **h k c g l.**

Hence, "option 3" is the correct answer.
